questions.prompt: Two particles $A$ and $B$, of masses $3\text{ kg}$ and $2\text{ kg}$ respectively, are connected by a light inextensible string which passes over a smooth fixed pulley. The particles are released from rest with the string taut.

parts.label: a
parts.prompt: Find the magnitude of the acceleration of the particles and the tension in the string.

questions.prompt: Two particles $P$ and $Q$, of masses $1.2\text{ kg}$ and $0.8\text{ kg}$ respectively, are connected by a light inextensible string passing over a smooth fixed pulley. The system is released from rest.

parts.label: a
parts.prompt: Calculate the tension in the string during motion and find the magnitude of the total force exerted by the string on the pulley.

questions.prompt: A particle $A$ of mass $m\text{ kg}$ ($m > 1.5$) and a particle $B$ of mass $1.5\text{ kg}$ are connected by a light inextensible string over a smooth fixed pulley. When released from rest, particle $B$ ascends with an acceleration of $2.5\text{ m s}^{-2}$.

parts.label: a
parts.prompt: Calculate the tension in the string and determine the value of $m$.

questions.prompt: Two particles $C$ and $D$, of masses $4\text{ kg}$ and $M\text{ kg}$ ($M < 4$) respectively, hang vertically from opposite ends of a light inextensible string passing over a smooth fixed pulley. The tension in the string during motion is $32\text{ N}$.

parts.label: a
parts.prompt: Find the acceleration of particle $C$ and deduce the value of $M$.

questions.prompt: Two particles of masses $5\text{ kg}$ and $3\text{ kg}$ are connected by a light inextensible string passing over a smooth fixed pulley. The system is released from rest.

parts.label: a
parts.prompt: Find the acceleration of the system and calculate the speed of each particle after $1.5\text{ s}$.

questions.prompt: Two particles of masses $m_1 = 3.5\text{ kg}$ and $m_2 = 1.5\text{ kg}$ are connected by a light inextensible string passing over a smooth fixed pulley. The system is released from rest.

parts.label: a
parts.prompt: Calculate the tension $T$ in the string, and explain why $T$ is less than the weight of the $3.5\text{ kg}$ particle and greater than the weight of the $1.5\text{ kg}$ particle.

questions.prompt: Two particles $A$ and $B$, of masses $0.7\text{ kg}$ and $0.3\text{ kg}$ respectively, are attached to the ends of a light inextensible string that passes over a smooth fixed pulley. The particles are initially held at rest with both particles hanging vertically at the same horizontal level. The system is then released from rest.

parts.label: a
parts.prompt: Find the acceleration of particle $A$ and the tension in the string.

parts.label: b
parts.prompt: Find the time taken for particle $A$ to descend $0.5\text{ m}$, and calculate the vertical distance between the two particles at this instant.

questions.prompt: Two particles $P$ and $Q$ have masses $0.6\text{ kg}$ and $m\text{ kg}$ respectively, where $m < 0.6$. The particles are connected by a light inextensible string passing over a smooth fixed pulley. When the system is released from rest, particle $P$ descends $1.8\text{ m}$ in $1.2\text{ s}$.

parts.label: a
parts.prompt: Show that the acceleration of particle $P$ is $2.5\text{ m s}^{-2}$, and calculate the tension in the string.

parts.label: b
parts.prompt: Find the value of $m$, and determine the magnitude of the force exerted by the string on the pulley.

questions.prompt: Two particles $A$ and $B$, of masses $1.6\text{ kg}$ and $0.9\text{ kg}$ respectively, are connected by a light inextensible string passing over a smooth fixed pulley. An additional constant downward force of magnitude $5\text{ N}$ is applied to particle $A$. The system is released from rest with the string taut.

parts.label: a
parts.prompt: Form the equations of motion for both particles, find the acceleration of the system, and determine the tension in the string.

parts.label: b
parts.prompt: Find the distance moved by particle $A$ when its speed reaches $3.6\text{ m s}^{-1}$.

questions.prompt: Two particles $P$ and $Q$, of masses $1.25\text{ kg}$ and $0.75\text{ kg}$ respectively, are connected by a light inextensible string that passes over a smooth fixed pulley. The particles are released from rest with both particles hanging vertically at a height of $2\text{ m}$ above horizontal ground.

parts.label: a
parts.prompt: Find the acceleration of the particles, the tension in the string, and the speed of the particles at time $t = 1.0\text{ s}$ after release.

parts.label: b
parts.prompt: At the instant $t = 1.0\text{ s}$, the string suddenly breaks. Assuming $Q$ does not reach the pulley, calculate the greatest height above the ground reached by particle $Q$.

questions.prompt: Two particles $A$ and $B$, of masses $0.8\text{ kg}$ and $0.2\text{ kg}$ respectively, are connected by a light inextensible string passing over a smooth fixed pulley. The particles are held at rest with particle $A$ at a height of $1.2\text{ m}$ above the floor and particle $B$ resting on the floor with the string taut. The system is released from rest.

parts.label: a
parts.prompt: Calculate the acceleration of the system, the tension in the string, and the speed of particle $A$ immediately before it strikes the floor.

parts.label: b
parts.prompt: When particle $A$ strikes the floor, it comes to rest without rebounding and the string becomes slack. Calculate the additional distance particle $B$ ascends before coming momentarily to rest, and state the total height of particle $B$ above the floor at this instant.

questions.prompt: Two particles $P$ and $Q$, of masses $3\text{ kg}$ and $1\text{ kg}$ respectively, are attached to the ends of a light inextensible string that passes over a smooth fixed pulley. The pulley is at a height of $5\text{ m}$ above horizontal ground. The particles are released from rest from a position where both particles are hanging vertically at a height of $1.6\text{ m}$ above the ground.

parts.label: a
parts.prompt: Show that the acceleration of the system is $5\text{ m s}^{-2}$, calculate the tension in the string, and find the speed of particle $P$ at the instant it strikes the ground.

parts.label: b
parts.prompt: Particle $P$ hits the ground and does not rebound, causing the string to become slack. Calculate the maximum height reached by particle $Q$ above the ground, and confirm that $Q$ does not reach the pulley.

parts.label: c
parts.prompt: Assuming particle $P$ remains stationary on the ground, find the time that elapses between the moment $P$ strikes the ground and the moment the string becomes taut again.

questions.prompt: Two particles $A$ and $B$, of masses $0.7\text{ kg}$ and $2.5\text{ kg}$ respectively, are connected by a light inextensible string that passes over a small smooth fixed pulley. The pulley is fixed above a horizontal floor. The particles are released from rest with particle $B$ at a height of $0.8\text{ m}$ above the floor and particle $A$ on the floor with the string taut.

parts.label: a
parts.prompt: Form the equations of motion for both particles to find the acceleration of the system, the tension in the string, and the total force exerted by the string on the pulley.

parts.label: b
parts.prompt: Calculate the time taken for particle $B$ to reach the floor, and find the speed of the particles at the moment of impact.

parts.label: c
parts.prompt: When particle $B$ strikes the floor, it comes to rest without rebounding. Particle $A$ continues to move freely vertically upwards under gravity until it reaches its highest point and then falls back to the floor. Calculate the maximum height reached by $A$ above the floor, and find the total time elapsed from the initial release of the system until $A$ returns to the floor.
